content: 2. Template clustering: Upon converting human summaries into templates, we cluster them into $N$ clusters with the goal of using any template from the same cluster interchangeably. A template is first converted into embeddings using a pretrained BERT model BIBREF19, where template embedding is constructed by average pooling word embeddings. Templates are then clustered using k-medoid.
